entries.title: Deadly Strike
entries.summary: A chance per hit to multiply the hit's physical damage, ×2 by default and more with Deadly Strike Damage.

entries.title: Deadly Strike Damage
entries.summary: Raises the damage multiplier of every crit and Deadly Strike: +50% turns ×2 into ×2.5.

entries.title: Crushing Blow
entries.summary: A chance on hit to remove a share of the target's current life. ESR halves it against most targets and cuts it hardest against bosses.

entries.title: Bleed
entries.summary: Physical hits make the target lose a percent of that hit's physical damage over a few seconds, like poison.

entries.title: Physical Damage Leeched as Life
entries.summary: Heals you for a percent of the physical damage you deal; divided by 25 in Nightmare and 150 in Hell.

entries.title: Physical Damage Leeched as Mana
entries.summary: Restores mana from a percent of the physical damage you deal; divided by 15 in Nightmare and 75 in Hell.

entries.title: Life / Mana on Striking
entries.summary: A flat amount of life or mana each time your attack hits, melee or ranged. No difficulty penalty.

entries.title: Life / Mana after each Kill
entries.summary: Restores a flat amount of life or mana whenever you kill a monster.

entries.title: Physical Resist (Damage Reduced by %)
entries.summary: Cuts physical damage you take by a percent, capped at 50%. Also shrinks Crushing Blow against you.

entries.title: Damage Reduced by N
entries.summary: Subtracts a flat amount from every physical hit you take, before physical resist.

entries.title: Magic Damage Reduced by N
entries.summary: Subtracts a flat amount from each fire, lightning, cold and magic hit you take. Not poison.

entries.title: Fire, Cold, Lightning, Poison and Magic Resist
entries.summary: Cuts elemental damage you take by a percent. Nightmare and Hell subtract a large penalty, so stack well above the cap.

entries.title: Maximum Resist
entries.summary: Raises the 75% resistance cap for one element, up to a hard ceiling of 95%.

entries.title: Poison Length Reduced
entries.summary: Shortens how long poison lasts on you, and the poison damage with it. By vanilla rules the difficulty resist penalty also applies.

entries.title: −% to Enemy Resist
entries.summary: Lowers the target's resistance to your damage of that type. It cannot break an immunity.

entries.title: Elemental and Magic Absorb
entries.summary: Turns part of the elemental damage that gets through your resists into healing. Percent absorb caps at 40%.

entries.title: Attack Rating and Chance to Hit
entries.summary: Decides whether your attacks hit. ESR uses a much steeper curve: you need about 5× the target's defense for an even chance.

entries.title: Ignore Target's Defense, −% Target Defense, −N Monster Defense per Hit
entries.summary: Lower or skip the target's defense for your hit roll, which matters a lot under ESR's steep hit curve.

entries.title: Enhanced Damage
entries.summary: Raises damage by a percent. On weapons it boosts the weapon's base damage; elsewhere it boosts your total weapon damage.

entries.title: Cannot Be Frozen / Half Freeze Duration
entries.summary: Cannot Be Frozen removes both freeze and chill on you; Half Freeze Duration halves both.

entries.title: Slows Target
entries.summary: Each hit slows the target's movement and attack speed by the percent, for about 30 seconds. Bosses are capped at 50%.

entries.title: Freezes Target
entries.summary: A chance on hit to freeze the target solid for a short time; bosses and uniques are only chilled.

entries.title: Knockback
entries.summary: Hits can push the target back a short distance, interrupting it. Large monsters are pushed less often, small ones every time.

entries.title: Damage Taken Goes to Mana
entries.summary: A percent of the damage you take, after resistances, is added to your mana.

entries.title: Attacker Takes Damage
entries.summary: Deals flat damage back to anything that attacks you in melee or hits you with a missile. Physical thorns kills count as yours.

entries.title: Chance to Cast
entries.summary: A percent chance to cast the listed skill at the given level when the trigger happens: hitting, attacking, being struck, killing, casting or dying.

entries.title: Reanimate As / Slain Monsters Rest in Peace
entries.summary: Reanimate: killed monsters may rise as a named monster fighting for you. Rest in Peace: slain monsters cannot be raised.

entries.title: Increased Attack Speed
entries.summary: Shortens attack animations. Gains are in whole frames, so only breakpoints matter; the official Frame Table shows them.

entries.title: Faster Cast Rate
entries.summary: Shortens cast animations. ESR raises the useful cap from 200 to about 480 FCR; check breakpoints in the Frame Table.

entries.title: Faster Hit Recovery
entries.summary: Shortens the stagger animation after a heavy hit, so you act again sooner.

entries.title: Chance to Block and Weapon Block
entries.summary: Chance to block attacks with a shield, up to 75%. Dexterity raises it, level lowers it; ESR has low class base values.

entries.title: Faster Block Rate
entries.summary: Shortens the block animation, so you can block again and act sooner.

entries.title: Faster Run/Walk
entries.summary: Raises walking and running speed, with diminishing returns. ESR characters already run faster than in vanilla.

entries.title: Dodge, Avoid and Evade
entries.summary: Chances to dodge melee, avoid missiles while standing, or evade both while moving. Each is capped at 75%.

entries.title: Magic Find
entries.summary: Better chance that a drop is magic, rare, set or unique. Diminishing returns for rare, set and unique, with an ESR bonus on top.

entries.title: Extra Gold from Monsters
entries.summary: Raises the gold in each gold drop by the percent.

entries.title: Increased Quantity of Items Found
entries.summary: A chance for each monster you kill to drop extra items from its own drop table. 100% means one extra pick.

entries.title: Skill Cooldown Reduction
entries.summary: Shortens skill cooldowns by the percent; each skill has a floor, usually 20% of its base cooldown (an 80% cap).

entries.title: +% to Fire, Cold, Lightning or Poison Spell Damage
entries.summary: Raises your damage of that element by the percent, for skills and for that element's damage added to attacks.

entries.title: Magic, Physical and Total Spell Damage
entries.summary: ESR stats that raise skill damage: magic spells, physical spells, or a separate total multiplier on some skills.

entries.title: Summon Damage, Life, Resists and Limit
entries.summary: ESR stats that strengthen your summons: damage, life, resistances and how many non-unique summons you can have.

entries.title: +Skills
entries.summary: Adds levels to skills: all skills, one class's skills, one skill tab, or a single skill. Oskills give a skill to any class.

entries.title: Curse Duration Reduced
entries.summary: Shortens curses cast on you by the percent; 100% makes you immune to curses.

entries.title: Piercing Attack
entries.summary: A chance for your arrows and other missiles to pass through a target and hit the next one.

entries.title: Experience Gained
entries.summary: Adds a percent to the experience you get from kills.

entries.title: Light Radius
entries.summary: Changes how far around you the game lights the area. Mostly cosmetic.

entries.title: Requirements and Level Required
entries.summary: Changes the Strength, Dexterity or level needed to equip the item.

entries.title: Prevent Monster Heal, Hit Blinds Target, Hit Causes Monster to Flee
entries.summary: Vanilla on-hit effects that are almost absent from ESR items.

facts.label: Life leech divisor
facts.note: Life leech % is divided by this.

facts.label: Mana leech divisor
facts.note: Mana leech % is divided by this.

facts.label: Leech precision
facts.note: Leech is kept in 1/64 of a percent after the divisor: floor(leech × 64 / divisor).

facts.label: Crushing Blow share of current life per target (melee, one player)
facts.note: Vanilla share × setting / 100. Classes do not stack: mercenary → act_boss → super_unique → unique → champion → minion → monster. The config comments disagree with the values: unique = 25 gives 6.25 % of current life, but its config comment says "50 -> 12.5 %". The value is what the plugin reads.

facts.label: Critical multiplier
facts.note: Deadly Strike, Critical Strike and weapon-mastery criticals share one doubling: only one of them applies per hit.

facts.label: Magic Find diminishing returns
facts.note: Magic items get the full MF.

facts.label: Magic Find soft tail, % of raw MF added
facts.note: Effective MF = dim × MF / (MF + dim) + MF × tail / 100 for unique, set and rare items.

facts.label: Faster Cast Rate cap
facts.note: FCR past this point does nothing. Effective FCR = 120 × FCR / (FCR + 120).

facts.label: Dodge, Avoid and Evade cap
facts.note: Per-stat overrides of -1 inherit cap_percent. The stat on items is not changed, only the roll.

facts.label: Resistance penalty
facts.note: Added to fire, cold, lightning and poison resist.

facts.label: Hit chance curve
facts.note: r = attack rating / defense. Below the pivot 100 × r^s / (r^s + pivot^s), above it 50 + 50 × (r − pivot) / ((r − pivot) + tail), the late tail blended in between blendStart and blendEnd; whole percents, snapped to 100 at snapTo100At, then the limits.
